text:
Zoe (PM): Kicking off a focused DP run to test churn risk + acceptance signals. Proposal: 7 partners, 8-week window, with a churn-monitoring dashboard and automated acceptance rubric. Goal: figure out what onboarding indicators predict an ongoing paid relationship.
Marcus (Eng): Interesting metric set. Can we surface early indicators: time-to-1st-success, % automated tests passed, and number of integration blockers? We should emit these to the Console.
Hana (ProdOps): Ops asks: enforce a 72h pre-onboard smoke, partner access window, and a mandatory dry-run. Capacity: reserve 1 GPU equiv per partner for week1, then scale down if stable.
Leo (Design): For partner experience, reduce friction by bundling a minimal config template and a "prompt mapper" sample. Also propose an onboarding checklist with time estimates so Sales can set expectations.
Priya (CS): Churn signal idea: partners who fail to hit "time-to-first-success" within 5 business days are 3x more likely to drop. Let's track that and try interventions: office hours, prioritized bug fixes, or extra credits.
Zoe (PM): Love the intervention idea. Let's make a table of triggers + responses. Example triggers: `tff>5d`, `2+ regressions flagged`, `no login to Console in 7d`. Responses: proactive call, one-click rollback offer, or escalate to SE.
Marcus (Eng): Implementation note: we'll add a small eval harness that runs 20 canonical prompts daily and reports regressions per partner. Snippet: ```/evals/run?partner=acme&suite=onboard-20``` Results go to Console and a Slack channel.
Hana (ProdOps): Legal + access: Private partners need a signed DPA + access SLA. LegalBot  can you queue a templated DPA for these partners? Also I'll own the access window scheduling.
LegalBot: DPA template queued. Reminder: include data retention window, audit access, and encryption clauses. Route to legal-review channel when ready.
Leo (Design): Feedback loop: weekly 3-question pulse + in-product regression report. Also run a mid-cohort 30m interview for qualitative signals. We'll provide a short script for interviews.
Priya (CS): Incentives: offer tiered credits based on engagement milestones (e.g., credit after 2 weeks of active usage + case study opt-in). We'll track redemption in the intake sheet.
Zoe (PM): Acceptance rubric draft (numeric): 1) Onboarding completion within 10 days (score 0/1), 2) Automated eval regression <4% (0/1), 3) Active usage (tokens/day >= partner-declared threshold for 7 consecutive days) (0/1). Acceptance if sum >=2. Thoughts?
Marcus (Eng): Add stability gate: no >1 P1 incident in first 14 days. Also add a post-acceptance follow-up at 30 days to check retention.
Hana (ProdOps): Operational checklist items: access form signed, pre-onboard smoke green, backup rollback snapshot, and partner runbook shared. I'll publish a template.
Zoe (PM): Recruitment filter for Sales: 1) realistic tokens/day estimate, 2) product/infra lane, 3) willingness to participate in weekly feedback, 4) legal readiness for DPA. Put a short outreach blurb in the sheet.
Priya (CS): I'll create the onboarding playbook for partners with suggested timelines and office hour slots. Also will coordinate credits with Finance.
Marcus (Eng): I'll wire the eval harness and push a limited dashboard so the team can see churn signals. Snippet for trigger handler: ```if ttf>5d: create-ticket(priority=high, team=cs)```
Zoe (PM): Next steps: Marcus = eval harness + dashboard, Hana = access SLA + template, Leo = interview script + pulse survey, Priya = incentive structure + playbook, LegalBot = DPA draft. Reconvene Tue 10am. Any objections?
Leo (Design): No objections. Will post materials to #product by Monday.
Hana (ProdOps): I'll book a dry-run for Fri.
Priya (CS): I'll add candidate partner names to the recruit sheet and ping Sales.
Marcus (Eng): I'll post an initial dashboard link once the harness is up: https://redwood.example.com/dashboards/dp-churn.
Zoe (PM): Thanks all. Aim to capture two sample "rescue" workflows (technical vs commercial) so CS can triage early churn. I'll draft them and share.
